test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.**

Move ahead or forward steadily and gradually
solution: The correct answer is '**Forge**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Forge**'. • **Forge**: move ahead or forward steadily and gradually. (लगातार और धीरे-धीरे आगे बढ़ें या आगे बढ़ें) • *Example: The ship **forged** ahead through heavy seas.* **Correct Answer:__** *Forge.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Forego**: to decide not to have or do something that you want. अभीष्‍ट काम को जान-बूझकर न करना; स्‍वेच्‍छा से परित्‍याग करना • **Parade**: an occasion when a group of people stand or walk in a line so that people can look at them. परेड, क़वायद, जुलूस • **Forerun**: go before or indicate the coming of. (पहले जाना या आने का संकेत देना) 44:T890, The correct answer is '**call**'.
